AUTHOR: Westergerling
TITLE: A deep learning-based model for automatic identification of mesopelagic organisms from in-trawl cameras
REGION: Norwegian Sea, West- and North-Norwegian fjords (2020-2024)
SPECIES: lanternfish (Myctophidae), silvery lightfish (Maurolicus muelleri), barracudina, larger pelagic fishes, krill, pelagic shrimp, gelatinous zooplankton, squid
DATA: Own Deep Vision in-trawl camera images from IMR surveys 2020-2024 (white, red gain 1.5, red gain 5)
V_EV: Sec. 3: 'weighted mAP was higher and less variable in white (Wte: 0.93-0.95) compared to red gain 1.5 (R1.5te: 0.67-0.79) and red gain 5'
D2: 60/20/20 stratified by class, per light dataset
D_EV: Sec. 2.3.1: 'The three datasets were divided into training (tr), validation (va) and test (te) sets (60:20:20) using stratified partitioning'
R_EV: Sec. 3.3.1: best model 'training set: WRnstr' (all years and light types combined) tested on Wte, R1.5te, R5te from the same image pool
C_EV: Sec. 2.4: 'confidence threshold was set to 0.05... selected following an exploratory analysis (S2 Fig)'; Sec. 2.3.5: 'up to 50 FPs and 50 FNs were randomly selected' and labelled by cause
E_EV: Sec. 2.4: 'Weighted mAP and F1-score were chosen as key metrics'
METR: weighted mAP, AP per class, precision, recall, F1-confidence curves, FP/FN error analysis
NOTE: Split unit: annotated images (randomly extracted ~200 per sampled layer, plus selectively chosen images) split 60:20:20 stratified by class; no grouping by haul/survey -> image random. Not clear whether single-light models (Wtr) were tested on the other light test sets; headline model trained on all years/light types -> R1=N (verify Fig 5a). V1 coded 기타 정량 for measured strobe light spectra (Sec. 2.2, Fig 3); V6=P for categorical light/gain strata. C5 from manual error analysis of sampled FPs (e.g., 82% of FP pelagic shrimp detections were duplicates; 44% of FP krill were missed annotations). Ecological use (complementing catch/acoustics) discussed but no comparison with catch. Images/annotations public at NMDC.
AUTHORS_FULL: Westergerling, T; Allken, V; Melle, W; Salvanes, AGV; Rosen, S
